checks: Independent receiver derives the closure and prefix without importing the projection constructor
The caller supplies the original plan, case inputs, decoder context, native binding context and target
An explicitly induced local plan is used only for checking; the retained record keeps the original plan identity
Every bundle is checked in an isolated directory containing only its native members
The study compares every retained field and target judgment directly with the complete source record
claims: Recorded-value judgment preservation and declared-prefix correspondence. No minimum-size, execution attestation, unavailable historical-record membership, new field-defect or fresh-execution claim.
comparators: Typed observation replay over explicit reference closure
Complete action records over transitive explicit argument and guard references
Complete action records over the conservative whole-block prefix
controls: Delete a prefix action whose return value is not referenced
frame: All 7,380 native receipts and 10,134 stage obligations already enumerated in results/ctf-comparison/formal-01/frame.json
literal_handling: Literal JSON values and path components are data, not declaration references
measures: Canonical serialized receipt and complete bundle metadata bytes
Native stored file bytes, file path count, unique content bytes and unique content count
Complete bundle metadata plus native file bytes, including full plan and native-context overhead
native_context: Carry the existing native binding profile and its metadata, including tools, LLVM probe/plugin identities, or SandMark protocol/catalog/input lock
native_history_control: A separate frozen paired execution compares a REVISIT stage over A-to-B-to-A with A-to-A, on CLEAN and M23, three carriers and two passes. Both declarations build A and B; REVISIT reads only the first and final A observations.
native_members: Every retained acquisition file or content-addressed byte object; exact member set is checked independently
parallel_handling: Retain every sibling in the final parallel block and retain original event ordinals
selection: Static closure of earlier obligation references in all gates and predicates, followed by the complete original action-block prefix through the last referenced action
title: Complete-prefix evidence for individual stage judgments
unit: One derived evidence bundle for one existing stage obligation; not a new native execution
